report_name: Ivanti Patches Critical RCE Vulnerabilities in EPM

vulnerabilities.name: Ivanti Endpoint Manager Remote Code Execution
vulnerabilities.description: Several critical, remotely exploitable vulnerabilities in Ivanti Endpoint Manager (EPM) that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code on the EPM server.

identities.name: Ivanti
identities.description: Vendor of the affected Endpoint Manager (EPM) software.

indicators.name: Ivanti EPM - IIS Worker Spawning Shell
indicators.pattern:
title: Ivanti EPM - IIS Worker Spawning Shell
id: 9b8a1b3c-7e4d-4f6a-8d2c-1b9e8a7b6c5d
status: experimental
description: Detects the IIS worker process (w3wp.exe) spawning shell processes like cmd.exe or powershell.exe. This is a strong indicator of web application compromise, such as the potential exploitation of vulnerabilities in Ivanti Endpoint Manager.
references:
  - https://www.securityweek.com/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-12
modified: 2026-08-12
tags:
  - attack.t1059
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\w3wp.exe'
    Image|endswith:
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the IIS worker process (w3wp.exe) spawning shell processes, a common post-exploitation technique for compromised web servers like a vulnerable Ivanti EPM instance.
